info.description: The public API of vukem-finances: read and write the data of one workspace with a bearer token that holds only the scopes it needs. Every operation names its scope in `x-required-scope`; a scope is a ceiling, never a grant: the role of the person who made the token limits it at every request. Money is an integer `*_cents` in the workspace currency. See docs/api.md for conventions, errors, idempotency, rate limits and versioning.
